title: The Lazy Way to Launch Your Online Business
promo_conflict: Sponsored-style walkthrough promoting InkJoy print-on-demand (and Everbee, Higgsfield)

idea.name: Custom pet photo pillows (POD)
idea.one_liner: Sell custom pet-shaped photo pillows via Etsy/Shopify fulfilled by InkJoy, marketed with AI-generated UGC video ads
idea.customer: pet owners (mostly women), holiday gift buyers
idea.offer: custom pet-shaped pillow from a customer photo
idea.revenue_model: product margin: ~$26 + $7 shipping retail vs ~$6.60 + $7 POD cost for 15in

key_quotes.quote: There's your ad that you literally could throw on Facebook and start selling these.
They literally take out the whole background for you.

claims.claim: Etsy competitor had 456 sales in 6 months
claims.quote: It's actually the pillow that is being sold right here, and they had 456 sales in just the last 6 months.

claims.claim: 236 sales in the last month per Everbee
claims.quote: And if I analyze the Whatever Be right here, you can see 236 sales in just the last month.

claims.claim: 12in sells for $19 on Amazon plus shipping
claims.quote: if I go to say a 12-in, which is what size this is here, it's selling for $19, and they are still charging shipping.
For a 15 in, you're looking at 6.60 and $7 for shipping.

claims.claim: 15in sells for $26 on Etsy plus $7 shipping
claims.quote: So, I come up here, go to the 15 in, and as you can see right there, it's $26.

claims.claim: DTC competitor has 20,000+ reviews and runs 1,000 Meta ads
claims.quote: Now, this company right here also is running 1,000 ads.

acquisition_channels.details: Facebook/Meta video ads using AI-generated UGC testimonial

ideas.delivery: InkJoy prints, removes background and ships; seller handles listings and ads
ideas.other_uk_rules: AI-generated fake testimonial ads breach DMCC Act 2024 fake-review ban and CAP Code; GPSR for consumer products

idea.name: Custom pet photo suncatchers (POD)
idea.one_liner: Sell personalised pet stained-glass-style suncatchers on Etsy/Shopify via InkJoy with strong infographic listings

key_quotes.quote: They only want to look at the visuals, so you have to make sure that you are making a visually appealing infographic

claims.quote: Right here, this one on Etsy has 880 sales in just the past 7 months.
And if I analyze this one, you can see 308 sales in just the last month.
This one, 1,000 sales in 25 months, and how much are they selling for this thing?
An 8-in right here, which is exactly what I have, $50, $50 each one, okay?

idea.name: POD swimsuit line

key_quotes.quote: I was actually looking at them because I was interested in maybe next year throwing together an entire swimsuit line with POD.
